guards.supported_platform: linux-x86_64 with existing Landlock ABI 4 and seccomp profiles

input_domain: Sealed generated PDF 1.7; zero-origin unrotated unscaled MediaBox equals CropBox
known_issues: Selected raster geometry detects blank pages, basic geometry mismatch and edge-contact risk only; not semantic visual equivalence, color/font correctness, accessibility or release.
The strict parser and rasterizer read global file structures to resolve pages; their process-local limits remain mandatory before parsing and decoding.
Default 32-page/8-MiB whole-file validation is unchanged; optional 512-page admission does not establish final report qualification.

The direct per-page native renderer registers its own parent-death signal and eight-second interval timer before descriptor-based exec. Interpreter startup before registration, arbitrary descendants, aggregate job resources and scratch cleanup after abrupt supervisor death remain unqualified. The version query uses a separately bounded direct-child launcher; the legacy whole-file version probe is unchanged.
Inherited descriptors are narrowly passed to the worker and closed for native raster children, not proof of complete OS or same-UID isolation.
Temporary scratch can remain after abrupt supervisor death. External job lifecycle and resource supervision are required.
Only the existing pinned Poppler binary, pypdf and Pillow versions are admitted; source hashes record exact shared helper dependencies.

native_executor_lifecycle.binary_privileges: root-owned regular binary; no set-ID, group/world write or file capabilities
native_executor_lifecycle.execution: same PID; execve using the verified close-on-exec binary descriptor
native_executor_lifecycle.kernel_guards: existing Landlock and network filter reapplied before binary exec
native_executor_lifecycle.parent_identity: direct launching worker PID and Linux creator thread

native_version_probe.disable_path: OMNIGENIS_PDF_RASTER_WINDOWS_DISABLED=1; existing adapter admission and direct identity helper; no fallback
native_version_probe.guards: Direct-parent registration, timer, resource limits, read-only Landlock and network filter before executable reads
native_version_probe.output: Same owned anonymous file for stdout and stderr; no pipe or report descriptor inheritance

protocol.identity: Exact PDF/IR/plan hashes and physical page count/interval
protocol.storage: Two distinct anonymous request/result files plus independently pinned private scratch directory descriptor
